JSON Schema Generator

Infer a draft-07 JSON Schema from sample JSON — nested objects, arrays, formats and required fields.

"required" lists every key seen in the sample — review it against your full dataset.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste sample JSON (object or array).
  2. Click Generate to infer the schema.
  3. Review detected types and string formats.
  4. Copy the schema or download schema.json.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the schema inferred?

The sample is walked recursively: objects become properties, arrays merge their item types, and strings are checked for date-time, email and UUID formats.

What does "required" contain?

All keys seen in the sample — inferred from a single sample, so review it against your real data.

How are mixed-type arrays handled?

Item types are merged with anyOf so every observed shape stays valid.

Which draft is generated?

JSON Schema draft-07, the most widely supported draft.
